templates.run.confirm: Start a new task execution for this template?
templates.empty: No templates in catalog. Check server logs for “Template cache initialized” and GET /api/templates.
templates.hint.title: Template catalog
templates.hint.body: Legacy V1 templates are hidden from this list. Create V2 templates with the wizard; publish on Review before schedules or governance-gated runs. Use Schedules or View jobs from each row.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.subtitle: Task execution history
jobs.hint.title: Execution history
jobs.hint.body: Filter by template id or trigger type. The list auto-refreshes every 2s while any run is QUEUED or RUNNING. Open Detail for structured run reports.
jobs.distributed.title: Distributed queue
schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.subtitle: Cron-driven template runs (requires data.generator.schedule.enabled on server)
schedules.hint.title: Server configuration
schedules.hint.body: Enable the schedule poller on the service node: data.generator.schedule.enabled=true. Cron uses Spring six fields (second minute hour day month weekday), e.g. 0 0 2 * * * for daily at 02:00. Only PUBLISHED templates are started; skips when a run is already QUEUED or RUNNING.
schedules.poller.off.title: Cron scheduler disabled
schedules.poller.off.body: data.generator.schedule.enabled is false on this server. Rows below are stored but will not trigger runs until the poller is enabled.
schedules.highlight.found: Located schedule #{{id}} from job link (row highlighted).
schedules.highlight.missing: Schedule #{{id}} was not found with the current template filter.
schedules.remove.confirm.title: Delete schedule {{id}}?
schedules.remove.confirm.text: This stops future cron triggers for this row.
schedules.form.templateId.help: Only PUBLISHED, non-archived templates appear. Publish from the template editor Review tab first.
schedules.form.cron.help: Spring six-field cron (second minute hour day month weekday). Use presets or live preview below.
schedules.form.enabled.help: When off, the row is kept but the poller will not trigger runs.
schedules.form.description.help: Optional note shown in the schedules grid.
jobDetail.title: Job detail
jobDetail.poll.active.body: This page refreshes every 2 seconds until the run reaches a terminal status. Use Cancel for QUEUED/RUNNING or Resume when PAUSED.
jobDetail.distributed.title: Distributed job
jobDetail.partition.title: Partition metrics
jobDetail.report.title: Run report
jobDetail.report.hint.title: Structured run report
jobDetail.report.hint.body: Per-stage row counts, durations, and error samples from sources, transformers, and sinks. Use this to pinpoint slow or failing stages.
jobDetail.report.col.name: Stage
home.title: Operator Console
home.subtitle: One place for Template V2 authoring, JDBC datasources, job history, and cron schedules
home.runtime.title: Server capabilities
home.workflow.title: Recommended workflow
home.workflow.step1.title: Configure datasources
home.workflow.step1.desc: Register JDBC under Datasources; add Kafka/Elasticsearch cluster ids in application.yaml (copy snippets on that page). Test connections before use in templates.
home.workflow.step2.title: Create and publish a template
home.workflow.step2.desc: V2 wizard: file sources support upload/paste; SQL sources pick a JDBC pool. Validate on Review, then publish (PUBLISHED).
home.workflow.step3.title: Run manually or on a schedule
home.workflow.step3.desc: Run from the template list, or bind a cron under Schedules (requires data.generator.schedule.enabled=true on the server).
home.workflow.step4.title: Monitor executions
home.workflow.step4.desc: Track history under Jobs (with distributed queue metrics when enabled); open detail to cancel/resume and jump to template or schedule.
home.areas.title: Areas
home.area.templates: Catalog, wizard editor, YAML mode, run and archive
home.area.datasources: Persisted JDBC configs, driver presets, connection test
home.area.jobs: Execution history, trigger filter, distributed queue summary
home.area.schedules: Cron schedules with cross-links to templates and jobs
home.area.migration: V1→V2 migration analysis (legacy ops; set VITE_ENABLE_MIGRATION=true)
editor.v1.note: V1 template — execution is retired. Wizard is read-only; recreate as Template V2 or enable legacy migration UI (VITE_ENABLE_MIGRATION=true).
editor.yaml.hint: YAML wins on Apply — confirm if the form was edited.
editor.yaml.ops.title: YAML operations
editor.yaml.ops.body: Sync from form exports the wizard state into the editor. Reload fetches the saved template from the server. Apply parses YAML and replaces the wizard (persisted templates save on Apply).
editor.yaml.sync.help: Replace editor text with YAML generated from the current wizard fields.
editor.yaml.reload.help: Discard local edits and load the last saved YAML from the server.
editor.yaml.apply.help: Parse YAML into the wizard and save when editing a persisted template.
editor.yaml.confirm.title: Apply YAML to draft?
editor.yaml.confirm.text: Form values will be replaced by the YAML content. Continue?
editor.hint.new.title: New Template V2
editor.hint.new.body: Set a name, then configure Sources, Transform, and Sinks. On Review: validate, save, and publish (PUBLISHED) before schedules or production runs can use this template.
editor.hint.sources.title: Template input sources
editor.hint.sources.body: Named pipeline inputs (not the Datasources admin page). SQL sources pick a JDBC pool; file types support upload or paste. See Datasources for JDBC/Kafka/ES registration.
editor.hint.transform.title: Transform step
editor.hint.transform.body: SQL runs on Calcite over pipeline rows; SpEL defines output columns. Use a transformer chain for multi-step transforms inside one template.
editor.hint.sinks.title: Output writers
editor.hint.sinks.body: Each writer sends rows to console, JDBC, Kafka, or Elasticsearch. JDBC pools are on Datasources; Kafka/ES cluster ids come from application.yaml.
editor.hint.execution.title: Execution policy
editor.hint.execution.body: IN_MEMORY keeps the full pipeline in the JVM (required for Preview). CHUNKED bounds memory for large runs. Configure sink error handling here.
editor.hint.workflow.title: Optional L2 workflow
editor.hint.workflow.body: Enable to orchestrate compute blocks with log, pause, branch, and invoke steps. Most templates use the top-level Sources / Transform / Sinks tabs only.
editor.hint.review.title: Publish and run
editor.hint.review.body: Suggested order: Validate → Preview (IN_MEMORY only) → Save → Publish → Run. Schedules and production runs require PUBLISHED status.
editor.migration.saveFirst: Save the template first to use migration tools.
editor.invalidId: Invalid template id — started new draft

source.empty: No sources — add one to configure inputs.
source.unsupportedType: Source type "{{type}}" is not editable in the form — use YAML mode to change it.
source.policy.title: Source policy
transform.type.help: SQL runs on the Calcite engine over pipeline rows; SpEL defines named output columns with expressions.
transform.sql.help: Calcite SELECT over the current row set. Default: SELECT * FROM input.
transform.chain.mode.help: Single applies one transform; chain runs multiple steps in order.
transform.chain.name.help: Optional label for this step in logs and workflow references.
transform.chain.name: Step name
workflow.disabledHint: Enable workflow mode to define L2 steps and compute blocks.
workflow.steps.title: Workflow steps
workflow.steps.type.help: Built-in workflow action. invoke_compute_block runs a compute block by id.
workflow.steps.params.help: Step-specific JSON (e.g. level and message for log steps).
workflow.steps.computeBlockId.help: Required for invoke_compute_block — must match a block id below.
workflow.blocks.title: Compute blocks
workflow.blocks.empty: No compute blocks — add one or enable workflow.
workflow.block.id.help: Unique id referenced by invoke_compute_block workflow steps.
workflow.block.transformLayout.help: Linear runs SQL/SpEL transformers in order; DAG wires named nodes with explicit dependencies.
workflow.dag.intro.title: Transform DAG
workflow.dag.intro.body: Each node references a transform id and optional output alias. Depends-on selects upstream node ids that must finish before this node runs.
workflow.dag.nodeId.help: Unique id within this block's DAG (used in depends-on).
workflow.dag.transformId.help: References a transformer step id from the linear chain or engine registry.
workflow.dag.outputAlias.help: Optional name exposed to downstream workflow steps.
workflow.dag.dependsOn.help: Upstream node ids that must complete before this node executes.
workflow.page.intro.title: L2 workflow (optional)
workflow.page.intro.body: Enable workflow mode to orchestrate compute blocks with log, pause, branch, and invoke steps. Each compute block has its own sources, transform, and sinks.
editor.yaml.unsaved: YAML edited — Apply to update the form or Sync from form to discard.
sink.empty: No writers — add one to configure outputs.
sink.unsupportedType: Writer type "{{type}}" is not editable in the form — use YAML mode to change it.

sink.options.title: Writer options (JSON)

review.preview.title: Preview (in-memory)
review.publish.confirm: Validate and publish this template for production runs?
review.tooltip.preview.ok: Save draft and run in-memory preview
review.tooltip.preview.v1: V1 templates: promote via Migration tab first
review.tooltip.run.ok: Save draft and start a task run
review.tooltip.run.v1: V1 templates: use Migration tab to promote first
review.publish.required.title: Not published yet
review.publish.required.body: Cron schedules and governance-gated runs require PUBLISHED status. Validate, then Publish before scheduling or production use.
datasources.title: Datasources
datasources.subtitle: Persisted JDBC configs (datasource_config); runtime keys merge YAML and database.
datasources.workflow.title: Tips
datasources.workflow.body: Pick a common JDBC driver preset first — switching presets updates the URL template. Test the connection before save. Templates reference these names as dataSourceId in Sources/Sinks.
datasources.col.name: Name
datasources.dialog.title: JDBC datasource
datasources.dialog.name: Name
datasources.dialog.name.help: Runtime key referenced by template SQL sources and JDBC writers (e.g. h2, prod-mysql). Cannot change after save.
datasources.dialog.url.help: Full JDBC connection URL including host, port, and database. Presets fill a template you can edit.
datasources.dialog.username.help: Database login user (optional for some drivers).
datasources.dialog.password.help: Stored encrypted when configured; leave blank on edit to keep the existing password.
datasources.dialog.driverPresetHint: Fills driver class and a JDBC URL template; edit host, port, and database as needed.
datasources.dialog.driverAlternateHint: On test/save the server tries alternate driver classes from the catalog when the JAR uses a different entry point.
datasources.dialog.driverBundledHint: Built-in driver selected — loaded in an isolated class loader; no JAR upload needed.
datasources.dialog.bundledDriverNote: Driver JARs for this database ship with the service. You can test the connection after save.
datasources.dialog.uploadHint: Upload only for custom drivers or databases without a built-in bundle.
datasources.dialog.driverCustomPlacehold: Or type the driver class name
datasources.remove.confirm.title: Remove datasource {{name}}?
datasources.remove.confirm.text: Runtime and persisted config for this name will be removed.
migration.title: Migration
migration.subtitle: Promote is disabled for COMPATIBILITY_ONLY templates (W3 policy S1).
migration.hint.title: Migration backlog
migration.hint.body: Use filters to find templates ready to promote, blocked, or pending compare/sign-off. Open a row in the editor Migration tab to analyze, draft, compare, sign off, and promote.
migration.filter.label: Filter
migration.filter.help: Narrow the backlog by migration readiness — not the same as classification (Exact, Adapted, etc.).
migration.col.name: Name
migration.panel.workflow.title: Migration workflow
migration.panel.workflow.body: Suggested order: Analyze → Draft (apply to editor) → Compare → Business sign-off → Promote. COMPATIBILITY_ONLY templates cannot be promoted.
migration.panel.analyze.help: Classify the V1 template and list blockers/warnings.
migration.panel.draft.help: Generate a V2 draft and optionally apply it to the wizard.
migration.panel.compare.help: Run V1 vs V2 sample compare and refresh inventory.
migration.panel.signoff.help: Record business approval before promote (when required).
migration.panel.promote.help: Persist the migrated V2 template and retire V1 editing.
migration.panel.draft.title: Migration draft preview
migration.panel.draft.applied: Draft applied — review in form or YAML mode
migration.panel.compare.summary: Compare: class={{class}} recommendation={{recommendation}} v1Rows={{v1Rows}} v2Rows={{v2Rows}} match={{match}}% report={{report}}{{warnings}}
migration.panel.inventory.missing: Inventory: no db-{{id}} row (run Compare or refresh inventory)
migration.panel.signoff.title: Business sign-off (db-{{id}})
migration.panel.signoff.approvedBy.help: Name or id of the business approver.
migration.panel.signoff.notes.help: Optional context recorded with the sign-off.
general.name.help: Display name in the catalog and job history.

general.generatorType.help: SYNC runs in the caller thread; ASYNC uses a thread pool.

source.policy.materialization.help: Optional materialization hint for the engine.
